text:
sara: heads-up — the Python sample app's async streaming example fails mypy for me.

sara: minimal repro:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
from typing import AsyncIterator

async def main():
    client = AsyncClient()
    stream = client.chat.stream("gpt-slim", prompt="hi")

    # mypy says: 'Object is not async iterable' here
    async for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```

sara: mypy error: "error: "Iterator[ChatChunk]" is not an async iterator". But the runtime yields fine.

jamie: hmm that sounds like our stubs declared the streaming endpoint as `Iterator[...]` instead of `AsyncIterator[...]`. Do you have the installed SDK version?

sara: 0.9.3 (pip). Sample app template pulled from docs.

alex: can you paste `pip show redwood` and the exact signature from the stubs?

sara: gist of stub: `def stream(self, model: str, **kwargs) -> Iterator[ChatChunk]: ...`

sara: runtime actually returns an async generator (so `async for` works at runtime) — just static typing mismatch.

mikhail: confirmed. Our autogen for the client generator currently emits sync iterator typing for streaming endpoints — legacy holdover from sync client codegen.

luis: ugh. That explains few user reports about pyright complaining too. Pyright treats `async for` usage as "Object is not async iterable".

jamie: temporary workaround: cast the call to AsyncIterator: `from typing import cast, AsyncIterator
stream = cast(AsyncIterator[ChatChunk], client.chat.stream(...))` — ugly but works. Or `# type: ignore` on the loop line.

sara: thanks, cast works. Would be great if the SDK could provide correct typing or overloads so templates are correct out of the box.

mikhail: agreed — this is a bug in the stubs generator. I'll file an issue and propose change: streaming endpoints get `-> AsyncIterator[...]` in async client stubs and `-> Iterator[...]` in sync client stubs. Also add test to ensure mypy/pyright CI checks sample apps.

jamie: also a DX note: docs currently show only the async example in the sample app but the typed signature in the installed wheel is wrong, so we should patch docs or publish a patch release.

alex: small patch suggestion (stubs gen): detect `streaming: true` + `client_mode == async` -> emit `AsyncIterator` import + return type. I'll open a draft PR.

mikhail: filing issue now, tagging runtime and build teams: #4567 (internal). Assigning to @jamie for follow-up and @alex for PR.

devx-bot: Created issue #4567 and linked PR draft (github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7890).

sara: awesome, thanks all. Will switch sample app templates to include a note with the cast until patch lands. :thumbsup:

luis: follow-up: we should also consider typing a generic `AsyncStream[T] = AsyncIterator[T]` alias exported from the package so docs can use it and it's clearer for users.

jamie: agree — adding that to the PR.

sara: leaving this thread here in case anyone else hits it.

alex: fyi, also found a related corner where streaming responses use `Union[Chunk, str]` in stubs; will normalize to `ChatChunk | str`. More details in PR comments.

mikhail: thanks — good catch. We'll aim to ship a patch cut this week.
